exercises.title: Suite Setup
exercises.description: Use Suite Setup to run code before all tests in a suite.
instructions: In Settings, add [Suite Setup] with keyword Log
Create a test case that logs 'Test 1'
exercises.initialCode:
*** Settings ***
# Add Suite Setup here

*** Test Cases ***
# Add test case here
exercises.solution:
*** Settings ***
Suite Setup    Log    Starting Test Suite

*** Test Cases ***
Test One
    Log    Test 1
hints: Suite Setup runs once before all tests
Syntax: Suite Setup    <keyword>    <args>
No brackets needed in Settings section
Check the log to see setup runs first

exercises.title: Test Setup
exercises.description: Use Test Setup to run code before each test.
instructions: Add Test Setup that logs 'Preparing Test'
exercises.initialCode:
*** Settings ***
# Add Test Setup here

*** Test Cases ***
# Add two test cases
exercises.solution:
*** Settings ***
Test Setup    Log    Preparing Test

*** Test Cases ***
Test One
    Log    First Test

Test Two
    Log    Second Test
hints: Test Setup runs before EACH test case
Useful for initializing test data
Each test gets fresh setup
Note how setup runs twice (once per test)

exercises.title: Test Tags
